headline: Today: stop gaining, earn your deficit back
summary: You've gained 2.4 kg in thirty days when you need to lose 0.83 kg weekly; today's choices determine if you fight back or surrender.
details: Stop the snacking cycle starting now: commit to strict Huel portions and planned meals only—no grazing before the weekend temptation arrives. Hit the rowing machine for 45 minutes today; this single session builds the kJ deficit you desperately need to close your 1.55 kg/week gap. Today decides whether you catch up or surrender the next 9 months to this losing battle.
